tags.name: Experimental
tags.description: Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

tags.name: Content System
tags.description: Admin API endpoints for building content layouts: applying one structural edit to a draft layout (`/_action/content-system/layout/{operation}`), committing one edit to a stored layout (`/_action/content-system/layout/{layoutId}/{operation}`), resolving and diagnosing a draft (`/_action/content-system/layout/diagnose`), and previewing a draft against real entity data (`/_action/content-system/preview/entity`). The registered building blocks these endpoints accept are introspected via the `/_info/content-system-*.json` routes.
